jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Employment Type: Full-Time, Mid-level

Department: Business Intelligence

CGS is seeking a passionate and driven Data Engineer to support a rapidly growing Data Analytics and Business Intelligence platform focused on providing solutions that empower our federal customers with the tools and capabilities needed to turn data into actionable insights. The ideal candidate is a critical thinker and perpetual learner; excited to gain exposure and build skillsets across a range of technologies while solving some of our clients’ toughest challenges.

CGS brings motivated, highly skilled, and creative people together to solve the government’s most dynamic problems with cutting-edge technology. To carry out our mission, we are seeking candidates who are excited to contribute to government innovation, appreciate collaboration, and can anticipate the needs of others. Here at CGS, we offer an environment in which our employees feel supported, and we encourage professional growth through various learning opportunities.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Complete development efforts across data pipeline to store, manage, store, and provision to data consumers.
Being an active and collaborating member of an Agile/Scrum team and following all Agile/Scrum best practices.
Write code to ensure the performance and reliability of data extraction and processing.
Support continuous process automation for data ingest.
Achieve technical excellence by advocating for and adhering to lean-agile engineering principles and practices such as API-first design, simple design, continuous integration, version control, and automated testing.
Work with program management and engineers to implement and document complex and evolving requirements.
Help cultivate an environment that promotes customer service excellence, innovation, collaboration, and teamwork.
Collaborate with others as part of a cross-functional team that includes user experience researchers and designers, product managers, engineers, and other functional specialists.

Qualifications

Must be a US Citizen.
Must be able to obtain a Public Trust Clearance.
7+ years of IT experience including experience in design, management, and solutioning of large, complex data sets and models.
Experience with developing data pipelines from many sources from structured and unstructured data sets in a variety of formats.
Proficiency in developing ETL processes, and performing test and validation steps.
Proficiency to manipulate data (Python, R, SQL, SAS).
Strong knowledge of big data analysis and storage tools and technologies.
Strong understanding of the agile principles and ability to apply them.
Strong understanding of the CI/CD pipelines and ability to apply them.
Experience with relational database, such as, PostgreSQL.
Work comfortably in version control systems, such as, Git Repositories.

Ideally, You Will Also Have

Experience creating and consuming APIs.
Experience with DHS and knowledge of DHS standards a plus.
Candidates will be given special consideration for extensive experience with Python.
Ability to develop visualizations utilizing Tableau or PowerBI.
Experience in developing Shell scripts on Linux.
Demonstrated experience translating business and technical requirements into comprehensive data strategies and analytic solutions.
Demonstrated ability to communicate across all levels of the organization and communicate technical terms to non-technical audiences.

Our Commitment

Contact Government Services (CGS) strives to simplify and enhance government bureaucracy through the optimization of human, technical, and financial resources. We combine cutting-edge technology with world-class personnel to deliver customized solutions that fit our client’s specific needs. We are committed to solving the most challenging and dynamic problems.

For the past seven years, we’ve been growing our government-contracting portfolio, and along the way, we’ve created valuable partnerships by demonstrating a commitment to honesty, professionalism, and quality work.

Here at CGS we value honesty through hard work and self-awareness, professionalism in all we do, and to deliver the best quality to our consumers mending those relations for years to come.

We care about our employees. Therefore, we offer a comprehensive benefits package:

Health, Dental, and Vision
Life Insurance
401k
Flexible Spending Account (Health, Dependent Care, and Commuter)
Paid Time Off and Observance of State/Federal Holidays

Contact Government Services, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants will be considered without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Join our team and become part of government innovation!

Explore additional job opportunities with CGS on our Job Board:

https://cgsfederal.com/join-our-team/

jobs.description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

Specs Inc. is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Snap Inc. dedicated to making computing more human. The company develops Specs, advanced eyewear that seamlessly integrates digital experiences into the physical world.

Specs feature see-through lenses that place digital objects directly into three-dimensional space, powered by Snap OS, a proprietary, context-aware operating system designed for natural interaction with your hands and voice.

Specs Inc. also provides Lens Studio, a full suite of advanced developer tools that powers immersive augmented reality experiences across Specs, Snapchat, and other services.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join the Specs team at Snap Inc!

What you’ll do:

Design, improve, and support reusable components, interactions, frameworks and SDKs that enable immersive experiences on Snap Spectacles Augmented Reality Glasses
Develop components of the operating system powering Spectacles, SnapOS
Participate in code and design reviews
Interact with design, interactive engineering, and product teams to shape and launch products

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Experience in one or more object oriented languages like C++, Kotlin or Java
Experience in delivering top quality, performant and scalable code with extensive unit / functional testing
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with high attention to detail

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, related degree or equivalent practical experience
5+ years of software development experience

Preferred Qualifications:

7+ years of experience building and shipping high performance code
Experience with operating systems, resource-constrained devices and 3d graphics
Practice designing SDKs, APIs and Platforms

"Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week.

At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.

Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long-term success!

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
About Jorie

Jorie AI, occupies a uniquely interconnected position at the center of the healthcare industry. An inseparable part of today's healthcare billing ecosystem, with leading edge technology that is driving transformation with AI infused Robotic Process Automation for end-to-end Revenue Cycle Management, providing practice and financial management services to the healthcare industry. Applied Intelligence, Better Insight, Accelerated Efficiencies with Jorie AI.

Our Work Environment

Growth advancement opportunities

Flexible work environment (Work-life Balance)

Collaborative and friendly company culture

Great Benefits

401(k) matching up to 4%

Medical

Dental

Vision

Long/Short Term Disability insurance

Life insurance $25,000 Paid by employer

PTO 2 weeks

10 and half Holidays

Overview

We are seeking a Software Engineer II to build and own intelligent automation for Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) in healthcare. With limited supervision, you will take features and automation workflows from requirements through to production. The work spans EHR systems, payer portals, clearinghouses, and internal services. You will partner with operations teams to turn manual workflows into reliable automation. You will also help Software Engineer I teammates grow through code review and pairing.

Key Responsibilities

Automation Development: Design, build, and maintain automation for RCM processes using Python, Selenium, and OpenCV, with limited supervision.
Feature Ownership: Take features from requirements through design, implementation, testing, and production release.
Computer Vision and OCR: Build reliable screen and document recognition with OpenCV and OCR, including handling popups, timing issues, and layout changes.
Production Support: Own the health of the automations you build. Find the root cause of failures from logs, screenshots, and database records, and fix them so they don't come back.
Data and SQL: Write and tune SQL for task queues, reporting, and analysis of throughput and exceptions.
Services and APIs: Build and maintain internal APIs, services, and integrations with payers, clearinghouses, and EHR systems.
Requirements and Estimation: Work with SMEs and operations to break manual workflows into steps that can be automated, flag edge cases early, and estimate the effort.
Code Quality: Write tests, review code, and keep automations maintainable.
Compliance and Security: Maintain secure credential handling, logging, and audit trails in line with HIPAA and HITRUST requirements.
Documentation: Create and maintain technical documentation for the workflows you own.
Cloud Services: Build on Azure services (e.g., Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Key Vault) to support scalable automation.
Mentorship: Support Software Engineer I teammates through code review, pairing, and technical guidance.

Requirements

Minimum of 3 years of professional software development experience.
Strong proficiency in Python, including maintainable, tested production code.
Hands-on experience with Selenium, Playwright, or another browser automation tool.
Proficiency with SQL and relational databases.
Experience building or integrating with REST APIs.
Experience debugging and supporting software in production.
Proficiency with Git, including branching and code review.
Working knowledge of healthcare RCM workflows (e.g., eligibility, authorizations, claims, denials), or of a similarly complex business domain.
Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical teammates.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
Web development experience with FastAPI, Flask, Django, or similar frameworks.
Production experience with OpenCV, OCR, or image processing.
Experience automating healthcare revenue cycle workflows.
Familiarity with healthcare data standards (X12 EDI 270/271, HL7) or EHR systems.
Experience with Microsoft Azure (e.g., Azure Functions, Key Vault, App Services) or another cloud platform.
Experience with Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
PowerShell scripting and Windows environment experience.
Experience with background jobs, task queues, or concurrent processing.
Automated testing experience (e.g., pytest), including mocking external systems.
Experience applying AI/ML or LLM tools to production problems.
Experience with logging, alerting, and observability tools (e.g., Grafana).

Must be legally authorized to work in the USA. No Contractors, No C2C, No Visa Sponsorship

No recruiting agencies.

Location & Hours:

Remote in USA Only. We cannot consider candidates from New York, California, or Washington state

Mon-Fri 8:00 AM to 5:00 PMCST

Flexible working hours may be required based on business

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Global E-commerce is a discovery-driven e-commerce business, working to become a destination for users to discover and buy good products at affordable prices. We build a shopping experience that feels tailored to each user, and a platform merchants can rely on across live and short-video commerce.

TikTok Shop is a more personalized way to shop, where joy, entertainment, and discovery meet. People engage directly with sellers and creators through shoppable videos and interactive livestreams, discovering and buying trending products without leaving the app. We want to be where people find innovative, unique, high-quality products from around the world, in an environment that stays safe and secure for sellers, creators, and users alike.

You will help redefine how people discover, search, and shop for the things they love, on a business expanding quickly across global markets.

The Global E-commerce Seller Business team plays a critical role in driving the success of our Global E-commerce platform. We are dedicated to building and nurturing a thriving ecosystem of local and global sellers who bring diverse products, brands, and innovations to our marketplace.
Our engineering team builds scalable systems and platform capabilities that support sellers throughout their journey on TikTok Shop, including onboarding, product management, order and fulfillment experiences, customer service, seller growth, and other core commerce capabilities.

Responsibilities:
- Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable backend services and systems supporting key e-commerce and seller experiences.
- Build reliable APIs and distributed systems supporting high-volume commerce workflows, data processing, and platform capabilities.
- Develop and improve technical solutions across areas such as seller onboarding, product and catalog management, orders, fulfillment, customer service, and seller growth.
- Improve system scalability, reliability, observability, performance, and operational stability for large-scale e-commerce services.
- Troubleshoot complex technical issues across distributed services and production environments and develop scalable, long-term solutions.
- Partner with Product, Operations, and other engineering teams to understand business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions that improve seller experience and platform adoption.
- Collaborate with globally distributed engineering teams to deliver platform capabilities supporting TikTok Shop's international growth.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
- 3+ years of experience developing highly scalable backend services and systems using at least one programming language such as Java, Golang, Python, Scala, or C++.
- Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, API design, and scalable system design.
- Experience building backend services, distributed systems, APIs, or other high-availability online systems.
- Strong programming capabilities with good code design and coding practices.
- Strong ownership and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across engineering, product, and business teams.
- Strong product and business understanding, with the ability to align engineering solutions with current and future business needs.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, seller platforms, merchant services, payments, SaaS, or other complex business platforms.
- Experience building seller- or merchant-facing systems, commerce infrastructure, or high-scale transactional platforms.
- Understanding of observability, reliability, data consistency, and performance optimization for large-scale distributed systems.
- Experience working with APIs, platform services, or third-party systems.
- Familiarity with modern AI-assisted engineering workflows and developer productivity tooling.
- Passion for programming, strong learning ability, intellectual curiosity, and a proactive mindset toward emerging technologies.

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request​

jobs.description:
MaxHealth
is seeking a Data Engineer for developing, maintaining, and supporting enterprise data pipelines and data integration solutions within MaxHealth's cloud-based analytics ecosystem. This role works closely with Data Platform Engineers, Data Analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure the timely, accurate, and reliable delivery of data used for reporting, analytics, and operational decision-making.

The Data Engineer will assist with modernizing legacy data processes, developing Azure Data Factory (ADF) pipelines, supporting Microsoft Fabric initiatives, and monitoring the quality and reliability of enterprise data assets.

Location
- Candidates must be located in the greater Tampa Bay region to be considered for this position. Tampa or Sarasota preferred with hybrid flexibility.

Required Qualifications

Experience with Membership and Enrollment data
4+ years of experience in data engineering, ETL development, database development, or related technical roles
Experience with SQL Server and strong SQL development skills
Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF), SSIS, or similar data integration tools (hands on Fabric and Databricks experience preferred)
Experience developing ETL/ELT processes and data transformation workflows
Scripting experience with Python, PowerShell, or similar languages
Understanding of relational databases and data modeling concepts
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Microsoft Fabric components as well as Databricks
Familiarity with Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 or cloud-based data platforms
Understanding of data warehouse and lakehouse concepts
Exposure to CI/CD practices and Azure DevOps
Experience working in healthcare, payer, provider, or regulated environments
Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Azure Monitor and Log Analytics

Preferred Certifications

Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) or equivalent foundational cloud cert
HDI Support Center Analyst or equivalent
Clinical application certifications a plus.

Key Responsibilities

Data Integration & Pipeline Development

Develop and maintain data pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF), Databricks, and/or Fabric
Support migration of legacy SSIS processes to modern cloud-based solutions
Build and maintain reusable ELT processes for data ingestion and transformation
Integrate data from operational systems, applications, APIs, and third-party vendors
Support data loading processes into data lake, warehouse, and reporting environments

Data Operations & Support

Monitor scheduled data pipelines and troubleshoot execution failures
Respond to data-related incidents and support operational data processes
Assist with root cause analysis and implementation of corrective actions
Work with Data Operations teams to ensure reliable and timely data delivery
Participate in production support and on-call activities as assigned

Data Quality & Validation

Implement data validation and reconciliation processes within pipelines
Monitor data quality, completeness, and accuracy across source and target systems
Investigate data anomalies and partner with business users to resolve issues
Support testing and validation efforts for new data integrations and enhancements

Database Development & Support

Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and database objects
Support database performance tuning efforts and indexing strategies
Assist with database maintenance and data management activities
Follow established security, compliance, and data governance standards

Documentation & Continuous Improvement

Maintain technical documentation for data pipelines, workflows, and integrations
Document data mappings, transformation logic, and operational procedures
Follow development standards, coding conventions, and deployment processes
Identify opportunities to improve data processing efficiency and reliability

About Maxhealth

MaxHealth is dedicated to simplifying healthcare and ensuring healthier futures-for our patients and our people.

Founded in 2015, MaxHealth is a leading primary care platform focused on delivering high‑quality, integrated, value‑based care to adults and senior patients throughout Florida. Today, we support more than 70,000 value‑based care patients through a growing network of more than 55 owned clinics and 30 affiliated practices across central and southern Florida.

Our success is driven by our people.
MaxHealth is home to a diverse, multidisciplinary team of more than 700 employees-including primary care providers, specialists, clinical staff, and corporate professionals-who are united by a shared purpose: to make healthcare simpler, more compassionate, and more human.

We are proud to offer a workplace that supports career growth, internal advancement, and work‑life balance
, with regular weekday office hours and a strong commitment to employee well‑being.

At MaxHealth, team members are encouraged to grow their skills, pursue leadership opportunities, and build long‑term careers in an environment where their contributions truly matter.

MaxHealth also partners with like‑minded independent providers, leveraging our platform to expand access to high‑quality care while preserving the personalized relationships that define great medicine.

Our values guide everything we do:
we are customer‑centered, compassionate, results‑driven, proactive, collaborative, and adaptable. These values shape not only how we care for patients, but how we support one another as colleagues.

Our mission is simple:
to deliver quality care, a simplified experience, and happiness-one patient, and one team member, at a time.
